sessions_realm_shape.name: sessions_realm_shape
sessions_realm_shape.value:
("sessions"."realm" = 'merchant' and "sessions"."interface" in ('manager', 'pos') and "sessions"."user_id" is not null
            and "sessions"."merchant_id" is not null and "sessions"."membership_id" is not null and "sessions"."operator_id" is null)
       or ("sessions"."realm" = 'platform' and "sessions"."interface" = 'platform' and "sessions"."operator_id" is not null
            and "sessions"."user_id" is null and "sessions"."merchant_id" is null)

link_page_items_emoji_valid.name: link_page_items_emoji_valid
link_page_items_emoji_valid.value: "link_page_items"."emoji" is null or length("link_page_items"."emoji") between 1 and 16

link_pages_background_colors.name: link_pages_background_colors
link_pages_background_colors.value: ("link_pages"."background" <> 'custom' or "link_pages"."background_color" is not null) and ("link_pages"."background" <> 'gradient' or ("link_pages"."background_color" is not null and "link_pages"."background_color2" is not null))

cash_branch_transfers_amounts.name: cash_branch_transfers_amounts
cash_branch_transfers_amounts.value:
"cash_branch_transfers"."amount_sent_minor" > 0 and "cash_branch_transfers"."amount_sent_minor" <= 1000000000
       and ("cash_branch_transfers"."amount_received_minor" is null or ("cash_branch_transfers"."amount_received_minor" >= 0 and "cash_branch_transfers"."amount_received_minor" <= 1000000000))

cash_branch_transfers_status_shape.name: cash_branch_transfers_status_shape
cash_branch_transfers_status_shape.value:
("cash_branch_transfers"."status" = 'in_transit' and "cash_branch_transfers"."amount_received_minor" is null and "cash_branch_transfers"."received_at" is null and "cash_branch_transfers"."cancelled_at" is null)
       or ("cash_branch_transfers"."status" = 'received' and "cash_branch_transfers"."amount_received_minor" is not null and "cash_branch_transfers"."received_by_user_id" is not null and "cash_branch_transfers"."received_at" is not null)
       or ("cash_branch_transfers"."status" = 'cancelled' and "cash_branch_transfers"."cancelled_by_user_id" is not null and "cash_branch_transfers"."cancelled_at" is not null and "cash_branch_transfers"."amount_received_minor" is null)

cash_disbursements_shape.name: cash_disbursements_shape
cash_disbursements_shape.value:
("cash_disbursements"."kind" = 'expense' and "cash_disbursements"."category" is not null and "cash_disbursements"."supplier_id" is null and "cash_disbursements"."purchase_order_id" is null)
       or ("cash_disbursements"."kind" = 'supplier_payment' and "cash_disbursements"."supplier_id" is not null and "cash_disbursements"."category" is null)

cash_disbursements_other_described.name: cash_disbursements_other_described
cash_disbursements_other_described.value: "cash_disbursements"."category" is distinct from 'other' or "cash_disbursements"."description" is not null

financial_accounts_custody_shape.name: financial_accounts_custody_shape
financial_accounts_custody_shape.value:
("financial_accounts"."kind" = 'register' and "financial_accounts"."register_id" is not null and "financial_accounts"."branch_id" is not null)
       or ("financial_accounts"."kind" = 'treasury' and "financial_accounts"."register_id" is null)
       or ("financial_accounts"."kind" not in ('register', 'treasury') and "financial_accounts"."register_id" is null and "financial_accounts"."branch_id" is null)

offer_items_names_present.name: offer_items_names_present
offer_items_names_present.value: length(trim("offer_items"."name_ar")) between 1 and 80 and length(trim("offer_items"."name_en")) between 1 and 80

shifts_closed_complete.name: shifts_closed_complete
shifts_closed_complete.value:
("shifts"."status" = 'open' and "shifts"."closed_at" is null) or ("shifts"."status" = 'closed' and "shifts"."closed_at" is not null
           and "shifts"."expected_cash_minor" is not null and "shifts"."counted_cash_minor" is not null
           and "shifts"."discrepancy_minor" = "shifts"."counted_cash_minor" - "shifts"."expected_cash_minor"
           and "shifts"."close_type" in ('normal', 'forced'))
          or ("shifts"."status" = 'closed' and "shifts"."closed_at" is not null and "shifts"."close_type" = 'forced_uncounted'
           and "shifts"."counted_cash_minor" is null and "shifts"."discrepancy_minor" is null)

modifiers_component_valid.name: modifiers_component_valid
modifiers_component_valid.value:
("modifiers"."component_variant_id" is null and "modifiers"."component_quantity" is null)
          or ("modifiers"."component_variant_id" is not null and "modifiers"."component_quantity" > 0)

payments_exchange_valid.name: payments_exchange_valid
payments_exchange_valid.value: ("payments"."method_kind" = 'exchange') = ("payments"."refund_id" is not null) and ("payments"."method_kind" = 'exchange' or "payments"."payment_method_id" is not null)

payments_amounts_valid.name: payments_amounts_valid
payments_amounts_valid.value:
"payments"."amount_minor" > 0 and "payments"."fee_minor" >= 0 and "payments"."fee_minor" <= "payments"."amount_minor" and "payments"."change_minor" >= 0
          and ("payments"."tendered_minor" is null or "payments"."tendered_minor" = "payments"."amount_minor" + "payments"."change_minor")

sale_overrides_used_consistent.name: sale_overrides_used_consistent
sale_overrides_used_consistent.value: ("sale_overrides"."status" = 'used') = ("sale_overrides"."used_at" is not null) and ("sale_overrides"."status" = 'used') = ("sale_overrides"."kinds" is not null)

sales_channel_valid.name: sales_channel_valid
sales_channel_valid.value:
("sales"."channel" = 'pos' and "sales"."order_id" is not null and "sales"."register_id" is not null and "sales"."shift_id" is not null
           and "sales"."membership_id" is not null and "sales"."user_id" is not null and "sales"."online_order_id" is null)
          or ("sales"."channel" = 'online' and "sales"."online_order_id" is not null and "sales"."shift_id" is null)

plans_limits_valid.name: plans_limits_valid
plans_limits_valid.value:
coalesce("plans"."max_branches", 1) >= 1 and coalesce("plans"."max_employees", 0) >= 0
          and coalesce("plans"."max_products", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("plans"."max_registers", 1) >= 1

stock_transfer_lines_quantities.name: stock_transfer_lines_quantities
stock_transfer_lines_quantities.value:
"stock_transfer_lines"."requested_quantity" > 0 and ("stock_transfer_lines"."dispatched_quantity" is null or "stock_transfer_lines"."dispatched_quantity" >= 0)
          and ("stock_transfer_lines"."received_quantity" is null or ("stock_transfer_lines"."dispatched_quantity" is not null and "stock_transfer_lines"."received_quantity" >= 0))
          and ("stock_transfer_lines"."recalled_quantity" is null or ("stock_transfer_lines"."dispatched_quantity" is not null and "stock_transfer_lines"."recalled_quantity" >= 0))
